definitions.explanation: An administrative division of Japan, similar to a state or province.

examples.japanese: {千葉県|ちばけん}に{住|す}んでいます。
{日本|にほん}には47の{県|けん}がある。
examples.notes: Technically 43 prefectures plus Tokyo (都), Osaka/Kyoto (府), and Hokkaido (道)

notes:
{県|けん} is Japan's main administrative division.

ADMINISTRATIVE DIVISIONS:
- {都|と}: Tokyo Metropolis
- {道|どう}: Hokkaido
- {府|ふ}: Osaka-fu, Kyoto-fu
- {県|けん}: 43 prefectures

COMPOUNDS:
- {県庁|けんちょう}: prefectural office
- {県民|けんみん}: prefectural residents
- {県立|けんりつ}: prefectural (institution)
